questions.subject: Reading
questions.learningObjective: Match paraphrased workplace requirements to named features by comparing conditions in a text.
questions.prompt:
Match the description to a named option in the text. Write its letter. You may use any letter more than once.

Staff can test how they would respond to rare cases without changing real customer information.
questions.passage:
Staff development at a community media centre

Desk Shadow gives new reception staff a half-day alongside an experienced colleague. Participants can take notes on how visitors are helped, but may not operate the booking system themselves. Supervisors choose the date.

Open Studio is for staff who already know the booking system but want to practise handling unusual situations. The trainer provides a copy of the booking screen with made-up records, so mistakes cannot affect live bookings. Workers can attend without approval from their supervisor.

Skill Exchange lets two teams request a session on a procedure they both use. One staff member from each team brings an example showing how the procedure works in their area. The session must be requested jointly.

Return to Work is for staff who have been away for at least six months. A trainer reviews changes made during the absence. If a staff member works evenings, the trainer can arrange the session after the usual office closing time.

External Award helps employees pay for a qualification delivered by an outside college. The centre reimburses part of the cost after the employee submits proof of successful completion.

Options
A. Desk Shadow
B. Open Studio
C. Skill Exchange
D. Return to Work
E. External Award
questions.explanation: Open Studio uses made-up records for practising unusual situations.

Employees need to hand over their parcel at the loading bay rather than the main desk.
questions.passage:
Courier services for branches of a printing company

Counter Transfer is the daily pouch between the two city branches. It accepts flat paperwork only and leaves Reception at noon. Any item for the pouch should be in a sealed envelope marked with the destination branch.

Workshop Run collects boxed samples for the production site on Tuesdays and Fridays. The driver does not call at Reception. Staff must take parcels to the loading bay before the listed collection time.

Direct Drop is for a one-off delivery outside the regular routes. It requires a manager’s approval before a courier can be booked. The cost is charged to the team that requested it.

Signature Return is for paperwork which must come back after signing. Include the return envelope provided by the dispatch clerk. The courier waits while the recipient signs, then brings the signed papers back on the same trip.

Secure Hold is for goods whose recipient cannot take delivery that day. The courier brings the goods to a locked depot instead. The recipient can arrange a later collection from the depot, but must bring identification.

Options
A. Counter Transfer
B. Workshop Run
C. Direct Drop
D. Signature Return
E. Secure Hold
questions.explanation: Workshop Run takes boxed samples from the loading bay and bypasses Reception.
